title: sheynkmanlab/lrp2 pipeline - params.input schema (BAM input)
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input (PacBio BAM files)

sample_name.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces. RNA and protein samples with matching sample_name and condition will be grouped together.

sample_path.errorMessage: Sample file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam', '.raw', '.mzML', '.mzml', or '.fasta' (for testing)

bam_id.errorMessage: BAM ID cannot contain spaces. For RNA samples, this must match the SM tag in the BAM header (e.g., BioSample_1). For protein samples, use 'None' or 'none'.

condition.errorMessage: Condition must be provided and cannot contain spaces. RNA and protein samples with matching sample_name and condition will be grouped together.

sample_type.errorMessage: Sample type must be either 'RNA' or 'protein'

mass_spec_type.errorMessage: Mass spec type must be 'DDA', 'DIA', 'none', or left empty. Required for protein samples (must be 'DDA' or 'DIA'). For RNA samples, use 'none'.

bam_id.errorMessage: bam_id is required for RNA samples and must not be empty or 'none'. It must match the SM tag in the BAM header (e.g., BioSample_1).
bam_id for protein samples may be empty, 'None', or 'none'.
